title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Printing and Issuing Several Opinions on Comprehensively Strengthening the Work of Accepting Supervision
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the "Several Opinions on Comprehensively Strengthening the Work of Accepting Supervision"

Fa Fa [2011] No. 14

To: the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region

The Several Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Comprehensively Strengthening the Work of Accepting Supervision are hereby issued to you. Please earnestly implement them in accordance with the actual work situation.

October 12, 2011

Several Opinions on Comprehensively Strengthening the Work of Accepting Supervision

Consciously accepting the leadership of the Party, the supervision of the People's Congress, the democratic supervision of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), the legal supervision of the procuratorial organs, and social supervision is an important element of the socialist judicial system with Chinese characteristics. It is an inevitable requirement for strengthening judicial democracy and promoting judicial justice. In order to effectively leverage the role of accepting supervision and promote the scientific development of the work of the people's courts, in accordance with the Constitution and laws, and in light of actual work, the following opinions are hereby put forward on comprehensively strengthening the work of the people's courts in accepting supervision.

1. Fully Recognize the Important Significance of the Work of Accepting Supervision

(1) Accepting supervision is the obligation and responsibility of the people's courts. Our country is a socialist country where the people are the masters of the country, and all power originates from the people and belongs to the people. Supervising judicial work is not only an essential requirement of a people's democratic dictatorship state but also a legal principle established by the Constitution and laws. As the state adjudicatory organs, the people's courts must always uphold the leadership of the Party. By deepening judicial transparency and extensively accepting supervision, they shall effectively safeguard the people's right to know, participate, express, and supervise judicial work, and truly realize, safeguard, and develop the fundamental interests of the people.

(2) Accepting supervision is an important guarantee for the people's courts to correctly exercise their adjudicative power. Strengthening the work of accepting supervision is conducive to the people's courts further standardizing judicial conduct, ensuring judicial integrity, lawfully and impartially exercising the adjudicative and enforcement powers entrusted by the people, better providing strong judicial guarantees for the overall work of the Party and the state, and providing quality judicial services to the people.

(3) Accepting supervision is an effective way for the people's courts to strengthen and improve their work and enhance judicial credibility. Judicial credibility is the foundation of the state's judiciary and the very foundation of the people's courts. Only by proactively placing adjudicative and enforcement activities under broad and open supervision can the people's courts continuously strengthen and improve their own work, effectively win the understanding and trust of the broad masses of the people and all sectors of society, further establish a good image of judicial fairness, integrity, and service for the people, and create a favorable environment for the work of the people's courts.

2. Further Clarify the Main Content of the Work of Accepting Supervision

(1) Consciously accept the supervision of the People's Congress and its Standing Committee. Earnestly complete the work related to reporting on the work of the people's courts to the People's Congress, and comprehensively listen to the deliberations and suggestions of deputies to the People's Congress. In conjunction with the annual work arrangements of the Standing Committee of the People's Congress and the work priorities of the people's courts, effectively prepare special work reports for the Standing Committee of the People's Congress. Conscientiously implement the deliberation opinions and relevant resolutions of the People's Congress and its Standing Committee. Actively cooperate with the Standing Committee of the People's Congress in carrying out various supervisory tasks such as inspections on the implementation of laws and regulations, review and filing of normative documents, and deliberations and decisions on personnel appointments and removals. With respect to opinions raised by the People's Congress and its Standing Committee during the deliberation of work reports and supervisory work, they shall be promptly studied, earnestly rectified, and relevant circumstances shall be reported to the Standing Committee of the People's Congress.

(2) Proactively accept the democratic supervision of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC). Further establish and improve the liaison and communication mechanisms with the CPPCC, as well as with the democratic parties, the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce, and personages without party affiliation. Through various forms such as holding symposiums, conducting joint research, and special investigations, report on work, solicit opinions and suggestions, and jointly discuss and resolve relevant issues, thereby effectively guaranteeing the democratic supervision of the CPPCC and the right of the democratic parties, the Federation of Industry and Commerce, and personages without party affiliation to participate in the deliberation and administration of state affairs.

(3) Conscientiously handle suggestions from deputies to the People's Congress, proposals from CPPCC members, and matters of concern to deputies and members. Focus on handling suggestions, proposals, and matters that are commonly cared about by the people and widely followed by deputies and members of the People's Congress and CPPCC, and timely transform them into important references for strengthening and improving work. Effectively strengthen communication with deputies, members, and relevant parties, promote mutual understanding and consensus between the proposing and handling parties, and continuously improve the quality of handling work.

(4) Actively carry out liaison work with deputies to the People's Congress and members of the CPPCC. Starting from issues of concern to the people and all sectors of society, enrich and innovate work forms and methods that are more in line with the actual work of the people's courts and that are convenient for deputies and members to accept, thereby effectively enhancing the effectiveness of liaison work, creating conditions and providing convenience for deputies and members to comprehensively understand and supervise the work of the people's courts. Pay attention to strengthening contact with relevant offices of the People's Congress and the CPPCC, and obtain their support for carrying out the work of accepting supervision.

(5) Cooperate with the procuratorial organs in carrying out legal supervision in accordance with the law. Adjudicate all types of appealed cases in accordance with legal procedures, earnestly listen to procuratorial suggestions put forward by the procuratorial organs in accordance with legal provisions, promptly inspect and correct problems existing in the process of case adjudication and enforcement, ensure that handling procedures are lawful, and that judgments are substantively just. Further improve the work mechanism for accepting legal supervision from the procuratorial organs in accordance with the law, and jointly safeguard judicial fairness and judicial authority.

(6) Effectively advance the work of special appointees of the people's courts. By appointing special consultants and special supervisors from among deputies to the People's Congress, members of the CPPCC, democratic parties and personages without party affiliation, experts and scholars, and personages from all sectors of society, fully leverage their role in decision-making consultation and judicial supervision, and continuously strengthen and improve the work of the people's courts.

(7) Extensively accept social supervision. Further deepen judicial transparency, provide a platform for the broad masses of the people and all sectors of society to comprehensively and objectively understand and supervise the work of the people's courts, and through forms such as setting up a president's mailbox and a public opinion communication mailbox, listen to public opinion and understand people's conditions. Effectively strengthen the analysis and research of opinions and suggestions raised by the people and all sectors of society, promptly handle and provide feedback, and actively respond to the concerns of the people regarding the work of the people's courts.

3. Establish and Improve the Institutional Mechanisms for Accepting Supervision

(1) Establish a targeted liaison system. People's courts at all levels shall implement a working mechanism for targeted liaison with deputies to the People's Congress, especially for deputies to the National People's Congress within their jurisdiction. Various forms shall be adopted to strengthen communication and enhance understanding. A special work ledger shall be established, plans and measures shall be formulated, implementation shall be carried out earnestly, and support from deputies to the People's Congress for the work of the people's courts shall be actively sought.

(2) Improve the work system for handling suggestions from deputies to the People's Congress, proposals from CPPCC members, and related matters. People's courts at all levels shall conscientiously implement the rules and regulations of the National People's Congress Standing Committee, the National Committee of the CPPCC, and the Supreme People's Court concerning handling work, further improve various handling working mechanisms such as centralized management, unified assignment,分级 responsibility (responsibility at different levels), tracking and supervision, and communication and feedback, to ensure that handling work is standardized and orderly.

(3) Improve the system for observing court trials. People's courts at all levels shall conscientiously summarize practical experience, further refine operating procedures, and fully leverage the role of observing court trials in standardizing judicial conduct and promoting judicial fairness. They shall proactively seek support from organs such as the People's Congress and the CPPCC to jointly promote the effective conduct of this work.

(4) Improve the system for reporting major work matters. People's courts at all levels shall promptly report on major work deployments, important work matters, and the adjudication status of major cases to deputies to the People's Congress, members of the CPPCC, and all sectors of society through forms such as convening meetings, compiling special publications, and issuing information releases, to ensure that they comprehensively and accurately understand the work situation of the people's courts.

(5) Improve the information reporting system. People's courts at all levels shall strengthen the summarization, analysis, and synthesis of new practices, new situations, and new problems arising in the work of accepting supervision, conscientiously do a good job in compiling and reporting work dynamics and information, and provide services for the leaders of the court and higher-level courts to grasp the situation and make scientific decisions.

4. Effectively Strengthen the Organizational Leadership of the Work of Accepting Supervision

(1) Establish a long-term mechanism. People's courts at all levels shall attach great importance to the work of accepting supervision, include it in important agendas, carefully study and formulate work plans for accepting supervision in light of local conditions, and timely deploy work tasks and clarify work requirements through forms such as regularly convening meetings and issuing documents, to ensure that the work of accepting supervision is carried out solidly.

(2) Strengthen the implementation of responsibilities. People's courts at all levels shall implement a president responsibility system for the work of accepting supervision, effectively establish a working mechanism for accepting supervision that features "leadership taking the lead and full participation," strengthen inspection, supervision, and guidance on the work of accepting supervision, and ensure that all systems and measures are implemented.

(3) Close coordination and cooperation. People's courts at all levels and in all localities shall strengthen their sense of the overall situation, firmly establish the thinking of the national courts as "a game of chess (one integral whole)," cooperate closely, form synergy, and jointly promote the in-depth development of the work of accepting supervision.

(4) Strengthen institutional construction. Each High People's Court and intermediate people's courts with conditions shall establish corresponding working institutions. Grassroots people's courts and intermediate people's courts that do not have the conditions to establish separate specialized working institutions shall be equipped with full-time personnel specifically responsible for the work of accepting supervision.

(5) Improve the assessment system. People's courts at all levels shall incorporate the work of accepting supervision into performance assessments, effectively mobilizing initiative and enthusiasm. Units and individuals with outstanding achievements in carrying out the work of accepting supervision shall be commended and rewarded. Those who cause adverse effects or other adverse consequences due to dereliction of duty shall be held accountable.

(6) Increase material support. People's courts at all levels shall provide necessary funds and equipment for carrying out the work of accepting supervision, effectively ensuring the smooth progress of daily work.
